narr: Thunderstorms with heavy rainfall occurred in central Goshen County, including Torrington where numerous reports of flash flooding were received. This included portions of Highway 26 underwater.
ev: Emergency manager reported water covering the right lane of US Highway 26 due to flooding between Torrington and Lingle.
Emergency manager provided a photo of street flooding at East F Street and 20th Ave in Torrington.
